evidence.claim: UniCredit is NOT a FINOS member
evidence.excerpt: UniCredit not listed among FINOS members (Platinum, Gold, Silver, or Associate tiers)

evidence.claim: TJ Lim (UniCredit) stepped down from ISDA Board in 2018 after 9 years of service
evidence.excerpt: TJ Lim of UniCredit stepped down from the ISDA Board after nine years of service. He played an integral role in helping ISDA and the broader industry adapt to regulatory changes.

evidence.claim: UniCredit deliberately chose not to register as CFTC swap dealer
evidence.excerpt: Italy's UniCredit has no interest in registering to trade OTC derivatives with US institutions. TJ Lim stated that 'uncertainty' over the rules meant UniCredit has 'decided not to register.'

evidence.claim: TJ Lim is current Group Chief Risk Officer at UniCredit (since 2017)
evidence.excerpt: TJ Lim serves as Group Chief Risk Officer at UniCredit SpA since 2017
